ReportProperties.Description: Due to the continued upheaval in Bergia, the Archpriest of Deyr has made the decision that the Archsanctuary, the most holy site of the Nurist religion, will no longer be holding public services. The building is currently surrounded by protective barricades and remains as yet unharmed.
ReportProperties.Title: Archsanctuary Closes To The Public

ReportProperties.Description:
The airforce generals have been working tirelessly along with their ATO counterparts to modernise our airforce. The regiments training have been changed to include more maneuvering exercises as well as night time bombing training.

Our warplanes have been retrofitted with the latest technology radar systems and cutting-edge bombs transported from Arcasia. General Staff reports that the Sordish Airforce has never been in a better condition.
ReportProperties.Title: ATO Modernises Sordland Airforce

ReportProperties.Description: The Air Force has issued a warning against non-essential air travel. Civilians are discouraged from booking flights except in the case of business purposes or to visit sick or dying relatives.
ReportProperties.Title: Air Force Issues Civilian Flight Warning

ReportProperties.Description:
Our Vice President, Petr Vectern, has been hosting massive rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Fortunately, the great charisma of the VP has led to many new voters to flock to the USP, the VP is shining while expanding the potential voter base.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Vectern Shines during Campaign

ReportProperties.Description:
Our Vice President, Petr Vectern, has been hosting rallies trying to sway both the conservative and reformist voters while also trying to attract new undecided voters.

Unfortunately, due to their close relationship with the administration and the unpopular reputation, the VP is struggling to draw in voters.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Vectern Struggles during Campaign

ReportProperties.Description:
At 7.00, Rumburg launched their tactical bombers ready to bomb our trenches across the border.

Our fighters attempted to limit their bombers' effectiveness. Dogfights occurred in the sky as bombs dropped across the battlefield for several hours straight.

At 10.00, Rumburg initiated an all-out assault with their tank columns leading the attack. Our hulled-down tanks managed to barely hold the line, while our infantry fought in the trenches nearby supporting them.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s First Wave

ReportProperties.Description:
After 3 hours of constant fighting the momentum of the Rumburg armies started to die down.

As General Valken was about to order an all-out assault to puncture Rumburg's defensive line at Crimsrad, news of our eastern front's collapse in Agnland arrived. Rumburgs military pressure started to mount up again following the event. 

As we were unable to send troops to support the eastern flank, the only option was to retreat all divisions back to Lachaven to avoid a full encirclement by the enemy.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s First Wave - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
After three hours of constant fighting, the momentum of the Rumburg armies started to die down.

General Kruger ordered an all-out assault to puncture their defensive line at Crimsrad. Before they could reorganize, Sordland's flag was already flying high in Crimsrad.

The news led to the collapse of Rumburg troop morale across the battle line. As we started gaining ground, Rumburg generals ordered a full retreat back to defend Tzarsbourgh to avoid a full collapse of the front, not realizing that our tanks and infantry were already assaulting Tzarsbourgh’s garrisons.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s First Wave - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

The meeting went well and the generals walked out of the room with an optimistic projection for the assault on Dome.
ReportProperties.Title: Optimistic Phase Two Meeting

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

However, the meeting quickly devolved into loud arguments between the generals, who walked out of the room with somber faces and pessimistic projections.
ReportProperties.Title: Loud Arguments In Phase Two Meeting

ReportProperties.Description:
Following the Sordish army’s successful invasion of Tzarsbourgh, our commanding officers held a meeting in the city itself to review the battle plans for the second phase of our military operation.

The meeting went well and the generals walked out of the room with an optimistic projection for the assault on Thornbourgh.
ReportProperties.Title: Phase Two Meeting

ReportProperties.Description: As part of the new order to secede Estord to Rumburg, population exchange of Sordish and Rumburgian citizens has begun. Police forces were assigned to the city to prevent potential violent escalations.
ReportProperties.Title: Population Exchange Begins

ReportProperties.Description:
At 7.00 in the morning, the Rumburg armies marched into the city of Estord. The city was empty, its citizens having been evacuated days earlier. 

At 9.00, while the Rumburg armies were savaging and looting what was left of Estord, General Lancea sounded the signal for an all-out assault. At 12.45, our first wave clashed with their southern flank.

At 15.13, our pincer attack started to take shape as the eastern and western armies began to enclose the enemy. The intensive fighting happened both in the sky and on the ground throughout the night.
ReportProperties.Title: Battle of Estord

ReportProperties.Description:
At 4.00 following the day, Rumburg troops defending the eastern front of Estord routed. In that crucial moment, Rumburg's commander made a decision that changed the tide of the battle.He ordered all divisions to withdraw to the central area of the city.

At 11.00, as our troops pushed in the vicinity from all sides, the Rumburg general ordered all his men to do a full assault to the east to break out. We were caught off guard and by the time the other armies got to the eastern front, the fighting turned into a melee. 

They managed to break our eastern front and stopped our pincer. With their rear free of our soldiers, they turned around and commenced a full assault on our remaining armies.
ReportProperties.Title: Battle of Estord - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
At 4.00 following the day, Rumburg troops defending the eastern front of Estord routed.

Our general commanding the army on the eastern side immediately signaled the victorious news to our headquarters and in the meantime telegraphed the news internationally and to all propaganda spies in Rumburg.

With their shattered eastern front, their flank was exposed and their supply lines were cut off. As we slowly gained ground, the Rumburg general capitulated.

At 14.00 on the same day, Sordland's flag was raised on top of Estord once again.
ReportProperties.Title: Battle of Estord - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
At 7.00, we initiated an all-out bombing and artillery barrage across Rumburg’s line in Crimsrad and the logistic points between Crimsrad and Tzarsbourgh.

At 7.30, our planes were spotted in Estord. Rumburg launched their fighters as a countermeasure to our air assault. 

At 9.30, General Lancea ordered the first army to push through the enemy line into Crimsrad. Our tank divisions in the first army charged forward, facing the Rumburg tanks head-on with our infantry behind to support them.
ReportProperties.Title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh

ReportProperties.Description:
As our armies were about to reach a breakthrough of Rumburg's defensive line at Crimsrad, news of our eastern front's collapse in Agnland arrived. Rumburg military pressure started to mount up. 

Because we couldn't support the eastern flank, the only option at the time was to retreat all divisions back to Lachaven to avoid a full encirclement by the enemy. 

Unfortunately, as we retreated, we suffered a very high amount of casualties.
ReportProperties.Title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
With our tanks leading the charge, we managed to push through Rumburg’s defenses. Before Rumburg could respond to our offensive, Sordland's flag was flying high in Crimsrad.

The news of the fall of the city led to the collapse of Rumburg troop's morale across the battleline. As we started gaining ground, Rumburg generals ordered a full retreat back to defend Tzarsbourgh to avoid a full collapse of the front, not realizing that our tanks and infantry were already assaulting Tzarsbourgh’s garrisons.
ReportProperties.Title: March Toward Tzarsbourgh - Conclusion

ReportProperties.Description:
Rumburg bombing runs began yesterday night. They have leveled most of the urban areas attacking hospitals and schools alike. There are many dead among the civilian populace. Local commanders report civilians and wounded children are inside their target areas.

We are sending more anti-air systems to Estord to defend the city but the local defences are heavily damaged.
ReportProperties.Title: Hospitals and Schools Bombed in Estord

ReportProperties.Description: We have received the schedule for the upcoming Alliance of Nations session. According to the dates outlined, Sordland One is being prepared for the flight to Konstantium, Kyrute. Minister of Foreign Affairs Deivid Wisci will be attending the session as well as accompanying Mr. President on the flight.
ReportProperties.Title: Schedule for the Alliance of Nations Session

ReportProperties.Description: The AN Ambassador has strongly condemned us after the recent rhetorical escalation against the Alliance of Nations. Sordland has received a warning that the international community will not stand by while our nation is adding fuel to the fire.
ReportProperties.Title: AN Ambassador Condemns Sordland

ReportProperties.Description: The AN Ambassador has extended their full support after the recent revelations about Rumburg on the international stage. Sordland has received a guarantee that the international community will stand by its territorial integrity and independence in these times. This boost the confidence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
ReportProperties.Title: AN Ambassador Supports Sordland

ReportProperties.Description: In light of the encroaching war with Rumburg, the USP Congress will not happen this year. President Anton Rayne retains his position as party leader, and will represent United Sordland as a presidential candidate in the coming elections.
ReportProperties.Title: USP Congress Cancelled

ReportProperties.Description: With the new powers that it has been granted, the Sordish military has assumed responsibility for keeping peace within Sordland’s borders, overriding local police authority. Extra troops have been dispatched to Camp Strongarm to manage the growing unrest in Holsord.
ReportProperties.Title: Military Assumes Interior Security Duties

ReportProperties.Description: With the emergency still being active during the elections, our police will be monitoring the voting procedures very closely to ensure the right votes are cast. The security forces will ensure that only the rightly 'eligible' and 'legal' votes can be cast at the ballot.
ReportProperties.Title: Emergency Extended Votes

ReportProperties.Description: A nationwide mobilization order has been issued to reinforce our manpower pool. New recruits will be mostly serving as reserves but we will prepare for the worst case scenario. Approximately one million men have been recruited so far and they will begin their accelerated training immediately.
ReportProperties.Title: Nationwide Mobilization Order

ReportProperties.Description: The Bank of Kyrute is happy to inform you that the transfer of your personal assets has completed successfully. It will take approximately 30 business days for the amount to be withdrawable in local territory. Thank you for choosing BoK.
ReportProperties.Title: Money Transfer Completed

ReportProperties.Description:
AN intelligence has confirmed that the information from the Rumburgian whistleblower was true. Rumburg does have nuclear weapons capable of threatening Sordland and Eastern Merkopa.

The Alliance of Nations ratified a barrage of sanctions on Rumburg by the member states.
ReportProperties.Title: Existence of Nuclear Weapons in Rumburg Confirmed

ReportProperties.Description:
Jubilant Sordish citizens in Holsord saw off hundreds of thousands Lespian soldiers and armored vehicles as they departed on the L-1-Railway to the Estord frontline.

Recordings and news of the massive, technologically advanced force have emboldened the morale of our soldiers as well as the war support of our citizens.
ReportProperties.Title: Morale Surges As Lespian Armies Depart Holsord

ReportProperties.Description: With the now ex-Interior Minister Lileas Graf challenging President Anton Rayne following her resignation, a congress has been called at which members of the USP will determine the party’s future leadership. At the Grand National Assembly, both Graf and Rayne will make speeches, after which the votes will be cast.
ReportProperties.Title: USP Congress Called

ReportProperties.Description: What was supposed to be a peaceful demonstration in downtown Jen turned violent as a number of participants brought weapons, leading to bloody clashes between protesters and counter-protestors. Several bystanders were caught in the crossfire; the number of wounded is not yet known.
ReportProperties.Title: Peaceful Protest Turns Violent

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Kyrute and its banking sector warmly welcome President Anton Rayne's decision to transfer personal finances to our trusted institutions. This act further solidifies the financial relationship between Kyrute and Sordland, and the Chancellor extends assurance of utmost security and confidentiality regarding these assets.
ReportProperties.Title: Presidents Finances Welcomed in Kyrute

ReportProperties.Description: Under the orders of the military, naval corps are being transferred from the Conriat Naval Base to the Port of Lachaven in order to better oversee the flow of imports and exports into and out of Sordland.
ReportProperties.Title: Navy Oversees Import and Export Flow

ReportProperties.Description: The debate between the candidates in the next Sordish presidential election is slated to take place tomorrow evening at the Sordish Broadcasting Corporation headquarters in Lachaven. It will be broadcast live on television, and several million households are expected to tune in.
ReportProperties.Title: Presidential Debate Prep in Lachaven

ReportProperties.Description:
Due to our reformist policies, a large majority of USP reformist voters said that they would likely vote for president Rayne.

In addition, our Vice President, Albin Clavin, has been hosting rallies trying to consolidate their support. Unfortunately, they are only the minority in USP so we may have to look for more votes elsewhere.
ReportProperties.Title: Vice President Clavin Consolidates Reformist Base

ReportProperties.Description: Sordish businessman, Walter Tusk, has officially endorsed us to be the next President of Sordland in the upcoming 57' election. With Mr.Tusk's wide-ranging connections and power, we can expect more business owners and pro-economy citizens to vote for us.
ReportProperties.Title: Walter Tusk Endorsed President Rayne

ReportProperties.Description: Our generals in the front line are requesting more ammunition, grenades, and medical equipment on the front line. According to their reports, our troops are barely holding the line and some of our soldiers can't even shoot back due to the lack of ammunition. Our Artillery units have to fire selectively which caused a big rift between our generals on where should our focus be. Unfortunately, we are straining our resources and won't have enough to support the entire front line.
ReportProperties.Title: Our Frontlines Request More Supply

ReportProperties.Description:
A flurry of activity in the skies above Lachaven is invigorating the region's military readiness. Our strategic allies from Lespia have dispatched their renowned air wings to our military airfields, executing daily drills as they prepare for the prospect of conflict. The state-of-the-art aircraft flown by these experienced pilots paint a formidable image of air supremacy. 

The spectacle is not merely a testament to our military preparedness; it has also become a profound morale booster for our ground troops. The presence of these skilled Lespian aviators signals strong ally support and deepens the resolve of our military personnel.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespian Airforce Soar in Sordish Sky

ReportProperties.Description: Our Generals sent us their deepest gratitude for our excellent administrative work on the home front. Our artillery units are continuously shelling the enemy without concern over ammunition. Thanks to the continuous supply of medical equipment, we have minimized the number of casualties. They were able to initiate continuous assaults due to the successes of the home front.
ReportProperties.Title: Our Generals Express Their Gratitude

ReportProperties.Description: As violent protests continue throughout Sordland, authorities in Lachaven are reporting out-of-control looting at the shops along Republic Avenue, with multiple windows broken and high-value items stolen.
ReportProperties.Title: Republic Avenue Looted

ReportProperties.Description:
The mayor of Lachaven has reported that Valgslandian transport ships have docked at the port and their troops are moving to the frontline. However, certain citizens have displayed animosity towards the Valgslandian soldiers.

Fortunately, no violence has occurred during the deployment of the troops.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Armies Arrived in Lachaven

ReportProperties.Description:
In the places Rumburg soldiers managed to break our defense, there have been atrocious reports of war crimes. These reports outline death marches on the dislocated civilian populations and mistreatment of prisoners.

According to a field commander they do not fight like a regular army. Reports of new chemical weapons have been sent over to Holsord. The war crimes will be reported to the international community for the whole world to see.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg War Crimes

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Lespia reaffirms its steadfast dedication to the alliance with Sordland. The Lespian Armed Forces remain prepared to stand in solidarity with our allies in any challenge that may arise. Should Sordland seek Lespia's support, our nation will respond without hesitation.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespia’s Army Stands Ready

ReportProperties.Description: The Republic of Lespia hereby reiterates commitment to peace in Eastern Merkopa. The tensions between Rumburg and Sordland have to be prevented to escalate further. We are strongly urging calm in the region.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespia Urges Calm

ReportProperties.Description: The Lespian military command joined with the Sordish military command. Latest reports are indicating that their armored and mechanized divisions are on their way to support the 1st Army.
ReportProperties.Title: Lespian Army on its Way

ReportProperties.Description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that roughly 27% of Sordish citizens would prefer to vote for the USP in the upcoming election.
ReportProperties.Title: Election Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description: Sordish citizens in Narbel started protesting the forced relocation following the order. Rumburgian flags were burned and during the increasingly violent protests, arson attacks occurred all over the city. Firefighters are attending the scenes.
ReportProperties.Title: Arson Attacks in Narbel

ReportProperties.Description:
We stopped the continuous shelling of Narbel by Rumburgian artillery. Yesterday night, our artillery brigades have targeted their locations and destroyed their heavy weaponry in a counter-artillery strike.

Our division will take this opportunity and attempt a breakthrough to create a pocket to trap the enemy tanks. Vectern Sis Da!
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg Artillery Targets Destroyed

ReportProperties.Description:
Reports are coming in that Wehzek soldiers have committed atrocities on their march through Narbel, specifically in the encampments where large numbers of Bludish and Rumburgian refugees from Lards and Datefort are housed.

Assault, looting and other violent acts are among the rumored war crimes.
ReportProperties.Title: Wehlen set Lards and Dateford in flames

ReportProperties.Description: In order to address the decades-long atrocities committed by Sordland once and for all, effective immediately, Her Majesty Queen Beatrice Livingston declares that a state of war exists in between the Kingdom of Rumburg and Sordland.
ReportProperties.Title: Proclamation of War

ReportProperties.Description: Rumburg closed all diplomatic channels with Sordland and blocked all incoming and outgoing communication. Our intelligence and army reports that the troop movements in the border are indicating a preparation for an invasion.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg Closes All Diplomatic Channels

ReportProperties.Description:
As the Wehzek army continues its march through Bergia, we are receiving reports of increasing casualties due to booby traps and raids by Bludish militants, presumably as an act of revenge for Operation Bear Trap.

The road along Gumren and Oldeburg has also been blocked with a dozen logs, further hindering their progress.
ReportProperties.Title: Roads along Oldeburg and Gumren Blocked

ReportProperties.Description: As unrest in Bergia continues, authorities in Uziren have reported an explosion at the city’s famous market. A homemade bomb appears to have gone off in an area with high foot traffic; the number of casualties is still unknown.
ReportProperties.Title: Explosion at Uziren Market

ReportProperties.Description:
Heavy fighting broke out as Rumburgian soldiers advanced on the defensive positions in Uziren. We have lost 87 soldiers, 2 tanks and 14 warplanes. Rumburg’s attack has been thwarted but the assaults are expected to continue.

Behind the frontline, a special operations team managed to sneak into the enemy territory and demolished the enemy anti-air systems. They were spotted by the enemy and an airstrike struck their position. The situation is expected to deteriorate.
ReportProperties.Title: Uziren War Report

ReportProperties.Description: With the election drawing near, our staff at the Maroon Palace has conducted general election polls all across Sordland. Our election polls show that roughly 16% of Sordish citizens would vote for the USP in the upcoming election.
ReportProperties.Title: Election Poll Results

ReportProperties.Description: The Democratic Republic of Valgsland reaffirms its enduring dedication to the alliance with Sordland. The Valgslandian Armed Forces stand ready to defend alongside our allies against any adversity. Should Sordland call upon Valgsland, our nation will respond without delay.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland’s Army Stands Ready

ReportProperties.Description: Valgsland's admirals have notified us that two different locations across Rumburg's eastern shores have been selected for amphibious landings. Furthermore, their massive fleet is ready to embark from Wilbern and Sigmort at a moment's notice.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Fleet Prepared To Embark

ReportProperties.Description: The Democratic Republic of Valgsland reaffirms its dedication to fostering peace in Eastern Merkopa. The rising tensions between Rumburg and Sordland must be prevented from escalating further. We strongly urge all parties to exercise restraint and maintain calm in the region.
ReportProperties.Title: Vaglsland Urges Calm

ReportProperties.Description: The Valgslandian officers joined with the Sordish military command to collaborate. Latest reports are indicating that their ships are on their way to blockade Rumburg’s supplies. Marines began their preparations additional military equipment is on its way to support the land troops facing Rumburg.
ReportProperties.Title: Valgsland Army on its Way

ReportProperties.Description:
Rumburg's navy has been spotted patrolling the Markian Sea. Even Sordland’s improved fleet has not been able to keep their ships entirely at bay. Reports of ships sunk in the naval battles are mounting substantially.

Fortunately, the losses are mainly on Rumburg’s side. With the Markian sea primarily under Sordish control, we have managed to sink or capture hundreds of trade ships carrying supplies for Rumburg, some even disguised as civilian boats.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg Ships Sunk and Captured in Markian Sea

ReportProperties.Description: Rumburg's navy has been spotted patrolling the Markian Sea. Despite our numerous attempts to assert control over the area, we could not contend with their superior submarine fleet. Hundreds of Sordish trade ships bearing war supplies have consequently been sunk before they could enter our ports.
ReportProperties.Title: Rumburg’s Navy Terrorizing Sordish Trade Ships

ReportProperties.Description:
We have received a communication from President Wiktor Smolak in response to the hostilities faced by the Wehlen army in the Bergia region. In his words: “Wehlen will not fight for a country that despises us.”

He has ordered his army to withdraw from Sordland, and sent an international diplomatic notice to the AN that Wehlen would not be taking part in the war against Rumburg.
ReportProperties.Title: President Smolak Withdraws Army
